title: The Cutting Edge: Week of May 24th
body:
**Highlights**
- AMA based on the proposed ‘[Original Podcast Series: How To Make It in Crypto-media](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series)’ by Wong Joon Ian and Petrit Berisha highlighted their low-cost strategy and unique plans gaining appreciation from several community members.
- The long-awaited ‘[Exchange A](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/827-proposal-top-15-exchange-by-cmc-integration-exchange-a)’ aka first official exchange [Bittrex Global announced listing](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1397212594537127947?s=20) and opened up trading for EDG with BTC and USDT pairs.
- OnFinality shared [Q2 Update](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1179-onfinality-public-nodes-q2-update) for their infrastructure of Public Nodes.
- Upcoming AMAs: [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/), [PicoSwap](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1138-introducing-picoswap-and-pico) and [Exit Theory](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project).


**Ecosystem Updates**
No major updates this week, just building.

**Governance**
- The [agency’s Treasury funding proposal](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1112-proposal-edgeware-agency-funding) for a 1-year of work span has been passed successfully. This has also become the referendum with the highest number of voters in the history of Edgeware’s Governance. {Referendum 39, Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove, Democracy Proposal ID:36, Treasury Proposal ID:31}
- [Treasury funding proposal](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1143-meta-transactions-on-edgeware) to integrate Biconomy’s multichain meta-transaction infrastructure on Edgeware EVM has also been passed successfully. {Referendum 40, Referendum type: Supe
